preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 3 and 10^5.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n(n - 1) / 2 or 10^5, whichever is smaller.
Each edge connects two vertices within the range from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: The graph does not contain any loops or parallel edges.
preconditions.description: Each edge is a simple edge connecting two distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to be added, t, is non-negative.
The number of ways to add the edges, w, is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: t == 0 if there exists an odd-length cycle in the graph, otherwise t > 0
postconditions.description: The value of t is determined by the presence of an odd-length cycle in the graph.
The value of w is determined by the number of ways to add edges to form an odd-length cycle.
